summary: Explains check mode (-C/--check), which runs the playbook without making changes and reports what would change, useful for testing and troubleshooting.
questions: How do I do a dry run of a playbook?
Can I test a playbook without changing my servers?

answer_card.title: Running in check mode
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-playbook --check playbook.yaml   # or -C
```

The playbook runs but makes no changes, and reports what it *would* have changed (files, commands, module calls).
